_comment: Source of truth for the app's CSS custom properties. Run `bun run tokens` after any change; scripts/app-tokens.test.ts fails when src/tokens.ts is stale, and measures every contrast claim below with site/scripts/check-contrast.mjs. Three layers: primitives (color, font, text, space, radius, shadow), semantic (what a value means) and component (what one part of the UI uses). Values here reproduce the v1.5 look exactly; a later PR swaps them for the chosen direction without touching a selector.

ink.role: Petrol ink. Text, rules, the primary button fill, the focus ring.

inkPress.role: The primary button fill while hovered.

paper.role: Cheque-paper mint. The page surface, and text on an ink fill.

slip.role: Receipt slips and plates. The only raised surface.

guilloche.role: The security-print line colour. A rule or a fill, never text.

mint.role: Done and success fills, under ink text.

frame.role: The mat behind a receipt image.

stamp.role: Rubber-stamp red. Needs-you and missing marks, counts, always with words.

stampTint.role: The pale red behind an alert.
